title: Inspection Version Impact v2
description: Classifies what a change to inspection semantics or a version bump means for a prior GeometryInspectionReport/GeometricFact — independent of GENERATOR_VERSION. See docs/bible/16-geometry-inspection/485-inspection-versioning.md.

changeLevel.description: PATCH: diagnostic wording only. MINOR: a new optional fact. MAJOR: a changed definition of an existing fact (e.g. connectivity/intersection semantics).
